statement_en:
Consider the probability space $(\{0,1\},\mathcal{P}(\{0,1\}),P_0)$, where $P_0(\{0\})=1-p$ and $P_0(\{1\})=p$. Define the Bernoulli$(p)$ random variable
$$Y_1(\omega):=\begin{cases}0& \omega =0\\ 1&\omega =1\end{cases}$$
Then its pushforward measure satisfies
$$P_{Y_1}(\{0\})=1-p,\qquad P_{Y_1}(\{1\})=p.$$

import Mathlib

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory

def Y₁ : Bool → ℕ
  | false => 0
  | true => 1

theorem bernoulli_pushforward_singletons
    (p : ℝ≥0∞) (hp : p ≤ 1) (P0 : Measure Bool)
    (hfalse : P0 ({false} : Set Bool) = 1 - p) (htrue : P0 ({true} : Set Bool) = p) :
    ((Measure.map Y₁ P0) ({0} : Set ℕ) = 1 - p) ∧ ((Measure.map Y₁ P0) ({1} : Set ℕ) = p) := by
